publicationText:
Joule Work after SAP Connect, explained as a conversation between two fictional AI hosts.

An editorial brief checked October 15, 2026: the interface, Knowledge Graph context, and SAP-managed activation through SAP for Me.

The announcement describes a beginning rollout with selected customers already using Joule Work. Check your organization’s availability and activation requirements before planning adoption. No customer environment was tested for this short.

Official guide: https://www.sap.com/topics/events/connect/innovation-news-guide-2026
Press release: https://news.sap.com/2026/10/sap-connect-sap-puts-autonomous-enterprise-to-work/
